parsed.rationale: The second member, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`, marking it as a test-support fixture. The near-identical shape between `AsyncNotificationMessage` and `MockNotificationMessage` is intentional: the mock protocol mirrors the production protocol so that test code can substitute a controlled implementation. The sole structural difference — `sending Notification` in `makeMessage` on the mock vs. plain `Notification` on the production protocol — further confirms the mock is deliberately adapted for the testing context rather than being an accidental duplicate. Collapsing these into a parent/child inheritance hierarchy would couple the production `Core` module to test-only concerns.
